description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The hybrid cloud cluster ID.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.
The list of API security event IDs.
The dimension of the security event.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)获取当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

description.zh:
事件状态。取值：

- **toBeConfirmed**：表示待确认。
- **confirmed**：表示已确认。
- **ignored**：表示忽略。
description.en:
The event status. Valid values:

- **toBeConfirmed**: To be confirmed.
- **confirmed**: Confirmed.
- **ignored**: Ignored.

title.zh: 批量修改API安全事件状态
title.en: Batch modify API security event statuses

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-apisec-events --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_000 --event-ids 7298c9f5b137c830000 --user-status confirmed --note already_confirmed. --cluster-id 428 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --event-scope ip --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyApisecEvents --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --EventIds.1 7298c9f5b137c830000 --InstanceId waf_v3prepaid_000 --ClusterId 428 --Note 'already_confirmed.' --EventScope ip --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --UserStatus confirmed
